recipe.title: Pumpkin Pancakes

steps.text: In a bowl, add 15 oz can pumpkin and 2 eggs; mix this up until it is nice and fluffy.
steps.label: Mix pumpkin
steps.doneness_cue: until it is nice and fluffy.

steps.text: Add 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1 tsp vanilla; mix this up.
steps.label: Add spices

steps.text: Add 1/4 cup oil, 2 1/2 cups flour, and 1 1/2 cups of milk; now mix it until combined (don't overmix).
steps.label: Make batter

steps.text: Put some butter on a pan and cook the pancakes like you would any other pancake.
steps.label: Cook pancakes

steps.text: There are two different ways to eat these pancakes. The first is the classic: serve with butter and maple syrup.
steps.label: Serve classic
steps.role_cue: There is two different ways to eat these pancakes.

steps.text: The other (the creator's favorite) is to top with chocolate chips (or chocolate syrup) and homemade Cool Whip.
steps.label: Serve with chips
steps.role_cue: But, then you have to try it my favorite way to eat it, which is with chocolate chips.

notes: Method grounded in the transcript (spoken walkthrough). I added ingredients that appear only in the transcript (butter; maple syrup; chocolate chips; chocolate syrup; homemade Cool Whip) with no quantities because the written ingredient list did not include them. I preserved quoted phrases from the transcript for doneness/role cues where present (e.g., "until it is nice and fluffy.", "There is two different ways to eat these pancakes.").

I did not mark serving steps as required because the transcript frames them as alternative ways to eat the cooked pancakes; I used the exact transcript phrases as role_cue and attached them to the cooking step.

source_text:
Title: How To Make Pumpkin Pancakes

Channel: This Crazy Kitchen

Video description:

Ingredients:
15 oz can pumpkin
2 eggs
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
1 tsp cinnamon
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
1/4 cup oil
2 1/2 cups flour
1 1/2 cups of milk

For items used in this video, check out my Amazon Storefront (https://amzn.to/3UX3fNZ)!

As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases.

Transcript (auto-generated captions, en):

Today, I'm going to show you how I make pumpkin pancakes, my kids' absolute favorite breakfast to eat. A few years ago, I wanted to make pumpkin pancakes. I looked for recipes. I could not find one that I liked. They all called for like a half a cup of pumpkin. If I'm eating pumpkin pancakes, I want some pumpkin in there. And if I open a whole can of pumpkin, what am I going to do with the rest of it? So, I made my own recipe, and I will share that with you today. All right, we are going to start with one 15-oz can of pumpkin, and we're going to add two eggs. And then we are going to mix this up until it is nice and fluffy. Now, we're going to add 1/2 a tsp of salt, 1/2 a tsp of pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp of cinnamon, 1/4 of a cup of brown sugar, packed brown sugar. And we're going to measure with our heart with vanilla, but it's going to be about a teaspoon, maybe two. And then we're going to mix this up. Now, we're going to add 1 tsp of baking powder. All right, now we're going to add 1/4 of a cup of oil, which I'm using lard, 2 and 1/2 cups of flour, and 1 and 1/2 CUPS OF MILK. >> [screaming] >> NOW, WE'RE JUST GOING TO MIX IT until combined. You don't want to overmix your pancakes. >> And the batter is done. Okay, we're going to put some butter on our pan. And we are going to make our pancakes like you would any other pancake. So, there is two different ways to eat these pancakes. The first one being like the classic with butter on top, our homemade butter on top. And maple syrup, of course. So, that is the classic way to eat it, which is delish. But, then you have to try it my favorite way to eat it, which is with chocolate chips. Or you can use chocolate syrup. But, we like to use chocolate chips. And some homemade Cool Whip on top. And that is how you make pancakes. Give them a try. They are delicious. They are nice and moist in the middle. They're not dry like regular pancakes. I seriously cannot eat regular pancakes. It's either pumpkin pancakes or potato pancakes, which I will be showing them soon too how I make them. But it's delicious. Um if you don't have chocolate chips, use chocolate syrup. So, I hope you give them a try. I hope you like them. That is all for today and I will see you later.
